Strong testing and engineering-craft background (TDD, CI/CD, test runners, testing workshops) matches the quality-focused responsibilities. Gaps are mostly framework-specific (no explicit Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, or Kotlin) and some breadth into niche stacks (DLang, Ember) that may need ramp-up, but these are easily bridgeable given demonstrated polyglot ability. Recommend interview with a focus on modern React/Nest.js depth and architecture scale.
